title: A new run served the previous run's reports as its own
foundBy: user report (host): "when we serve up the trajectories and the dispatch view, do we clean up the folders automatically before we do that? because we should if we don't"

evidence.verified: The next `make demo` printed `reset: moved the previous run's reports to .work/runs/20260918T235143Z`. With a dispatch page dated before its archive, `make show-reports` printed `is older than the archive` and exited 2.

details:
`demo-reset` left the previous run's archive, dispatch page and trajectories in `.work`. From `make demo-start` until the new archive step, `make show-reports` served the old pages. A stale archive also satisfied the guard in `make demo-destroy`, on behalf of a run that had no archive of its own.

`demo-reset` now moves those reports into `.work/runs`, under the time of the move. `make show-reports` also refuses a page that is older than the archive beside it.
